description: Agent cost and throughput parameters, low tier (Claude Sonnet 5 pricing). See paper/main.tex tab:scenario:agents. Tiers are ordered by model price, not by capability: r_bugs and d_test derive from vals.ai SWE-bench Verified scores (0.80/0.97/0.95 for low/medium/high), so they are deliberately non-monotonic across tiers. c_token is indexed by agent role 1-8 and is a cost per unit of that role's throughput rate; roles 4-6 (Refactoring, Code Review, Security Audit) have no countable unit of output, so r_k = 1 and c_token is a flat fee per deployed instance per sprint. r_refactor is denominated in D_tech units, not in work items.
